title: GenOn Kendall LLC (formerly Mirant Kendall, LLC; formerly Southern Energy Kendall, LLC) filed a Notice of Project Change to modify the cooling technology of the facility approved in the Final Decision EFSB 99-4, dated December 15, 2000.

Counsel for GenOn Kendall and City of Cambridge file joint comments
GenOn
Counsel for GenOn Kendall files corrected response and a revised supplemental response to EFSB’s Question 1
GenOn
Counsel for GenOn Kendall files 3rd supplemental filing to its Project Change consisting of Exhibit 17 and Exhibit 18
Counsel for GenOn Kendall and City of Cambridge jointly request additional 14-day extension to submit comments on Notice of Project Change
Counsel for City of Cambridge on its behalf and that of GenOn Kendall requests 14-day extension to submit comments regarding project change
Rae Stiening files letter of comment on proposed project change
Counsel for GenOn Canal files supplemental response to EFSB’s Question One, and second supplemental filing relative to the air cooled condenser (Exhibit 16)

Rae Stiening of Cambridge requests to be added to service list as an interested person

Presiding Officer forwards corrected Service List to parties
